title: A PRAYER FOR
YOUR HOME
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp light on wooden table with open vintage bible
soft focus olive branches in morning sun
peaceful countryside cottage window at dawn
gently flickering candle in quiet room
open bible with reading glasses on a table
soft sunlight through sheer curtains onto wood floor

scenes.a: If the noise of chaos in your home today has left you feeling completely exhausted, pray.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
Honor thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise; That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
Lord, pour Your gentle wisdom into every room of this house, turning hearts toward Your truth.
May our family walk in unity, grace, and deep love, reflecting the light of Your kingdom forever.
